C30.claim_en: Independently specified acquisition, error and continuation questions require native distinctions and shared boundaries. Joining probes further recover finite-fragment interfaces; the ternary relation determines unique unit roles, and complete finite traces recover their state interfaces. Global accounts remain eligible; capacity limits matching-unit sufficiency. The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness. The continuation derives finite-branch bisimulation from compound questions at shared conditions and reconstructs code histories lifting from every compatible native start; scoped structural uniqueness no longer requires determinism. Successor compactness further replaces finite branching, preserving structural correspondence and lifting whole infinite code runs; a genuinely infinitely branching positive model contrasts with equal finite-modal answers but different infinite realization. Joint questions further force step/joint correspondence under explicit correlated-pair compactness and lift finite nodewise plans; acquisition/release derives shared-support conflict. Complete isolated joint profiles can still lose designated-part aliasing, recovered by fixed-partner questions in the finite witness. Complete descendant support and sibling exclusion further connect arbitrary finite plans to distinct global requests and a common holding history; omission failures and a positive repair are checked. Every fixed n-ary success list can still miss an (n+1)-ary capacity restriction. Formation, withdrawal, acquisition and release have exact certificate-preservation conditions; every permitted finite history has a completing suffix in the same native law. Static lists can lose actual occupation, release/formation renew readiness, and an infinite permitted schedule can still never progress. All finite first-order identity, step and joint truths, even preserved by one coherent elementary map on every finite source tuple, do not force native isomorphism of wholly root-reachable worlds. F22.claim_zh: 继承校准、结构对手、组合唯一性及实际展开的接合／替换、分支继续与同规律错误反例；另增空历史探针、局部单位唯一性与关系同构下保持、完整接续充要条件和整个状态接口恢复。容量及内部序列丢失反例保留。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。 普遍化检验给出任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案与最少状态／边仍允许不同构机制，确定且可达、后续可区分时恢复唯一对应。 后续以共同条件下的复合接续问题推出有限分支双模拟，并由准确约简答案构造可从每个相容原生起点提升的编码规律；结构唯一性不再要求确定性。 再以后继紧致性放宽有限分支，取得结构对应及完整无限编码路径提升；有无限多个可区分后继的正例，也有全部有限复合答案相同而无限持续不同的反例。 共同问题再在明示成对紧致性下迫出步骤／接合对应并提升有限逐节点方案；实际占用／释放推出共享冲突。全部孤立共同问题仍可能遗漏指定部分的共享身份，固定搭配问题在有限实例中恢复。 再以完整下层支持覆盖及同级独占支持分离，将任意有限方案接到全局无重复与一次共同占用历史；遗漏关系的失败及修复正例均检查。每个固定 n 阶成功清单仍可漏掉 n+1 阶共享容量限制。 变化中的形成、撤去、占用与释放具有精确证书保持条件；任意允许有限历史在同一原生规律内都有完成后缀。静态清单会遗漏实际占用，释放／形成可恢复或建立准备；无限允许调度仍可能永不推进目标。 全体有限一阶身份、生成和接合真值一致，甚至有一个保留任意有限参数公式的映射，仍不足以迫出全范围可达结构的原生同构；Cantor 对角线给出真实不同构对手。保真映射再有全局覆盖则恢复同构。 Ren 非二元批评后的纠正：原反例未对准共同必要生成基础，不能作为原目标停止证据；给定位置之间可达未解释其构成性形成。 纠正后由同一部分接合关系形成全部有限情境，准确说明必须保留改变接续可能性的区别，冗余说明亦有共同因子；固定片段接合结果唯一时，共同内容带有唯一对应的操作。实际历史的全部嵌套接合问题恰好保留开始／结束接口，不抹去不同内部事件。 后续允许接合本身有多个结果：有限结果纤维及更丰富的分支问答迫出共同接合关系，原指定输入能实现每个代码结果；检验伙伴随同一编码转换，任意有限接合树提升。共同表示仍可有两个可区分结果。 不共用片段载体时，关联同测可导出单位置接合的共同细化及与既有投影相容的唯一保接合因子；但无引用关联问题会使所有有局部单位的片段同测，遗漏已消耗历史的不可自接合。保留同一配置的两个引用位置后，跨载体的有限形成历史可以匹配，精确说明必区分同一过程的空历史与已消耗历史。

The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise. The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness. The continuation derives finite-branch bisimulation from compound questions at shared conditions and reconstructs code histories lifting from every compatible native start; scoped structural uniqueness no longer requires determinism. Successor compactness further replaces finite branching, preserving structural correspondence and lifting whole infinite code runs; a genuinely infinitely branching positive model contrasts with equal finite-modal answers but different infinite realization. Joint questions further force step/joint correspondence under explicit correlated-pair compactness and lift finite nodewise plans; acquisition/release derives shared-support conflict. Complete isolated joint profiles can still lose designated-part aliasing, recovered by fixed-partner questions in the finite witness. Complete descendant support and sibling exclusion further connect arbitrary finite plans to distinct global requests and a common holding history; omission failures and a positive repair are checked. Every fixed n-ary success list can still miss an (n+1)-ary capacity restriction. Formation, withdrawal, acquisition and release have exact certificate-preservation conditions; every permitted finite history has a completing suffix in the same native law. Static lists can lose actual occupation, release/formation renew readiness, and an infinite permitted schedule can still never progress. All finite first-order identity, step and joint truths, even preserved by one coherent elementary map on every finite source tuple, do not force native isomorphism of wholly root-reachable worlds. Cantor gives a genuine obstruction; adding global coverage yields isomorphism. Following Ren’s nondual objection, the counterexample is not accepted as a stopping test for a common necessary generative basis: reachability between supplied positions does not explain their constitution. After correction, all finite contexts arise from the same partial joining law. Exact accounts must retain differences affecting continuation and have a common factor even when redundant. Functional fragment joining induces a common operation. All nested joining questions on admitted histories recover exactly their beginning/ending interface while internal event differences remain real. The continuation permits multivalued joining itself: finite outcome fibers and richer branch questions force a common joining relation; each code result lifts from the originally specified inputs. Partners in questions translate through the same encoding, and every finite joining tree lifts. The common account can retain two distinguishable outcomes. Across different fragment carriers, incidence agreement yields a common refinement with one-position lifting and a unique join-preserving factor commuting with given projections. Unanchored incidence questions nevertheless collapse all local-unit fragments, losing the spent history’s impossible self-join. Retaining two reference slots in the same configuration recovers matched finite formation histories; exact accounts must distinguish idle and spent histories within one process.

## 15. Different articulations: common refinement and the reference that must survive

**继续，2026-10-08。** 本轮得到共同细化及其准确范围，也发现并修复了一种真实的信息丢失：去掉片段名称后，如果问题每次只问“有某个伙伴”，已有局部单位的全部接合结构都可能被压成同一种回答。不能据此宣称找到了有内容的唯一基础。修复不需要重新预设独立对象，而要保留同一形成片段在后续接合中的共同指向；新的有限配置证明检查了这一连接。

```text

  joining records at their checked scopes. New: incidence-common-refinement,
  joining-open-map-factor, unanchored-incidence-collapse,
  retained-reference-joining-recovery.
Delta: compare different fragment types through role questions; construct a
  common relation and its projection-preserving factor; prove this unanchored
  language loses real joining distinctions; repair shared reference using
  retained configurations and lift their finite formation histories.
Supplied premises / correspondence: ternary joining interpretation; common
  role or slot-command grammar and exact complete question agreement. Incidence
  refinement uses locally finite incident joins and connected declared scope.
  Retained-reference recovery uses finite outcomes per fixed input pair and equal initial slot counts.
Evidence: 43 new Lean declarations, 213 inherited audits, 256 total;
  frozen receipt 20261008T134730.060831Z. No independent-agent review claimed.
Boundary: common refinement is mathematical, not proof of identical actual
  provenance. One-position lifting is not fixed-pair lifting. Configuration
```

The old §13 next connection has therefore advanced in two precise senses: a common refinement exists for the declared name-independent incidence target, and a stronger reference-retaining target matches formation across different fragment carriers. Neither claims that every equally adequate segmentation of actual reality already satisfies those target correspondences. The results live in the same study, with no new dated study copy.

## 16. A common refinement without a shared fragment carrier

For each J, an `Occurrence J` consists of three fragments and an actual `J first second result` witness. `Position J` displays either a fragment or one of these witnessed joins. Entering a join through a role and leaving it through a role are relations derived from J. The common question vocabulary uses only these six role movements, Boolean conjunction/negation and continuation; it has no native fragment constants or atomic valuation.

This analytical distinction between a fragment and a witnessed joining does not posit two fundamental kinds. Each displayed join is constructed from the same fragments and J. Conversely, using one representation does not derive J's real interpretation. A path in this incidence graph is a relational inspection path, potentially traversing a result back to its formation, not automatically a physically executable temporal history.

`match_incident` reuses the existing modal recovery theorem. Given equal role-question answers at x and y, and finitely many joins incident to y at each role, an actual join incident to x is matched by **one** join incident to y whose three positions all have matching answers. This condition is `LocallyFinite`: finite joins around a fragment/role, not the preceding weaker finite-results condition for a fixed input pair.

Define `Span J K` as all pairs of fragments with equal answers. Its joining relation holds exactly when the two coordinate joins both hold. `span_left_open` and `span_right_open` prove the projections preserve joins and lift every incident join while fixing one chosen participant. With equal answers at roots, local finiteness on both sides and incidence-connected declared scopes, `connected_common_refinement` proves both projections cover those scopes. A fragment map or bijection was not assumed.

The constructed span is a common **relational** refinement for this question family. It can contain several matches for a fragment; that is compatible with common content. Its existence is not evidence that two otherwise unrelated events share actual provenance or that every physical segmentation is adequately represented. The content and limits of its question family must still be tested.

## 17. The unique factor and its exact strength

`OpenMap J K p` explicitly means preservation of joining plus lifting an incident join while keeping one participant fixed. This is a substantial condition when supplied for a particular physical interpretation; it is derived for the span projections above rather than hidden in the definition of explanatory adequacy.

`open_map_bisimulation` and `open_map_preserves_questions` check that such a map preserves all role questions, without a finiteness requirement. If an independently supplied common refinement L has open maps p and q into J and K, each x in L consequently determines the span position `(p x, q x)`. `universal_common_factor` proves there is one and only one function into the span commuting with those two projections, and it preserves joins.

**The factor is not claimed to be open or onto.** The uniqueness concerns commuting with the supplied projections; it is not uniqueness of all carriers, all automorphisms, or all underlying realities. In particular, a local lift along each projection does not by itself synchronize arbitrary separately chosen participants. This exact qualification matters for the next test.

## 18. A substantive loss: unanchored questions erase all unital distinctions

The attempt to remove fragment names exposes a limitation stronger than a single artificial graph. `units_role_total` proves that, when J has local left/right units, each fragment participates in a join in each role. `units_collapse_open` then constructs an open map to the one-fragment joining relation. Hence `units_same_incidence_questions` proves that **any two fragments of any two such unital joining structures agree on every question of this unanchored incidence language**. No finite-fiber hypothesis is used in this collapse theorem.

This common answer pattern is too weak for the intended full joining explanation. The counterreview uses the already admitted histories of one process. An actual witness here means a `Trace` admitted by the supplied P, not an empirical observation or a claim that every admissible trace has been physically executed. By `trace_has_units`, every admitted history maps to the coarse account. Yet the actual spent history in `budgetProcess` cannot join with itself: its ending condition no longer matches its required beginning. The coarse account allows its one code to self-join. `open_map_does_not_force_pair_lifting` checks this exact failure. The same law's two boundary idles also agree on incidence questions while the inherited anchored boundary probes distinguish them.

No independent ethical predicate was toggled, and no difference of whole-world cardinality is used. The lost information is an actual continuation failure already witnessed in the same process. The coarse account is exact, even reduced, **for the incidence language**; it is not a sufficient account of the richer fixed-input joining task. The theorem diagnoses an omitted relationship in this representation. It does not refute the generative account or justify declaring the universal programme impossible.

The missing relationship is joint reference. “For this fragment, some compatible second fragment exists” may choose a new second fragment every time. “These two retained fragments can join” keeps both inputs fixed. “The very same fragment fills both inputs” needs no externally supplied name, yet distinguishes the spent history from its coarse code. Thus dropping native names must not also drop relationships that keep track of the same formed contribution.

## 19. Repair: retain references within formation and match the fixed inputs

`ExplanatoryJoiningRegisters` represents a finite retained configuration as a list of fragments. A command `(i,j)` selects the two positions **in that same configuration**. A valid response witnesses `J a b z` and appends z; it does not replace the previous entries. Natural-number positions refer to the configuration's own ordering, including positions formed by earlier responses. They are not common native fragment names shared between J and K.

The action and question types are now the same even when F and G differ. With equal initial slot counts and `FiniteOutcomes K`, `retained_pair_result_matches` proves that equal answers for two configurations force a matched result from the two actual corresponding retained slots. The resulting extended configurations again answer alike. This fixes both inputs before choosing the result; it does not settle them independently after the join. In contrast to the incidence route, only finite outcomes for each fixed input pair are needed.

With equal initial slot counts and finite outcome fibers on both sides, `retained_history_matches` carries any finite sequence of these formation commands across the comparison. Earlier results can be referenced in later commands, including in more than one subsequent position. `trace_retains_configuration` proves that the final configuration extends the original list rather than rewriting its old references. The same command sequence and an answer-equivalent final configuration are preserved. `trace_length` also proves that one slot is appended per command, so initially aligned slot counts remain aligned. Equal initial counts are explicit; answer agreement alone was not used to infer them. This generalizes the comparison scope beyond an unshared tree syntax, while keeping it a finite relational formation arrangement.

This is **not** a theorem that a resource can be physically copied, that every recorded fragment remains available after consumption, or that a queried arrangement has actually been executed. Whether references denote reusable patterns, retained records, or material conditions with continuing availability must be accounted for in J and the full realization model. The existing joint-support and acquired-record mechanisms remain completed at their own scopes; the current list construction does not redo or supersede them. It also does not establish cycles, infinitely completed formation, probability or a change in the granularity of the basic joining operation.

`singleton_self_question` connects the command `(0,0)` on `[x]` to `∃ z, J x x z`. The repaired language rejects the erroneous coarse self-join. More directly, `every_exact_account_retains_real_difference` proves that **within the same budget process**, every exact account of these retained questions distinguishes its initial empty history from its spent history. This last unavoidable-distinction theorem needs neither reducedness nor any finite-fiber assumption. The question is formed from joining and retained reference, with no separate success predicate.

## 20. Affirmative inference, counterreview and remaining universal connection

**正面推进。** 对“什么由什么形成，并怎样成为后续条件”的充分说明，保留有无某条关系还不够；如果后续作用取决于几个位置是否指向同一形成片段，这个共同指向也属于说明必须保留的内容。实际接续成败迫出这种区别。它不是先给出独立对象再外加关系的要求，也不是从逻辑语法直接证明现实的一元本体。

The substantive inference is conditional on the explanatory undertaking: when the continuation being explained depends on whether two positions reuse the same formed fragment, an account that forgets that relationship changes the explanandum. ## 95. 不共用片段名称的共同细化

现在比较片段类型不同的两种关系表述。问题先只使用一次真实接合中的三个角色：第一片段、第二片段、形成结果。片段与带有接合见证的组合一起构成关系图；这两个分析位置都从同一个接合关系形成，不是独立主体与外界。

在每个片段的每个角色周围只有有限次接合、所比较范围关系连通的条件下，根位置对全部这些有限问题给出相同答案，便能导出覆盖两边的共同关系细化。Lean 已证明：细化中的接合在两边都成立；固定一个参与位置时，两边的相应接合都能提升。不必预先给出片段双射。

这里的关系检查路径不等于物理时间历史；数学上存在共同细化，也不独自证明两个表述指向同一次实际发生。实际解释对应仍需有根据。

## 96. 唯一对应的一个更准确形式

若另一个共同细化已经有分别通向这两种表述的映射，并且映射保留接合、允许固定一个参与位置的接合提升，Lean 证明它有唯一函数通向上述共同细化，同时保持两边原有投影和接合。

这是一个准确的结构唯一性：唯一的是与两个既有投影相容的因子，不是所有完整现实必须一一相同。因子本身没有被证明仍满足单位置提升或覆盖全部位置；不能把“保留接合”与这些更强性质混同。

## 97. 不记住共同指向，会留下空泛共性

反审发现一个真实限制：若问题每次只问“存在某个伙伴”，就可能在每次回答时换掉伙伴。Lean 已证明，具有局部左右单位的任意接合结构，其所有片段对上述无名称关联问题都给出同样答案。这甚至不需要有限性。

这个共同答案模式不够解释完整接续。已有单次消耗过程中，有一步路径见证的消耗片段不能和自身接合，因其结束条件已经不再匹配开始条件；但压成一个代码的说明却允许自接合。它对前述狭窄问题确实精确，甚至最小，却对这个更丰富的接合任务失真。

这是同一已允许历史关系中的遗漏，有已有路径和失败见证；没有据此宣称已观测到物理事件。它不是通过任意改变谓词否定完整理论，也不构成生成根基不可能的证明。失败的是“只要去掉名称、保留存在关联，就足以保留生成内容”这条局部路线。

## 98. 从形成内部保留引用，而不预设共同对象名

修复的方法是保留已经形成的有限配置。问题指定同一配置里的两个位置，接合后把有见证的结果接在末尾，之前的位置不被换掉。位置编号来自这份配置自身的顺序；两种表述不需要使用同一种原生片段名称。

在初始配置具有相同位置数、对全部相应分支问题回答一致、每个固定输入对只有有限结果的条件下，Lean 已证明：固定两个原输入位置后，接合结果可以在另一表述中匹配；扩展后的配置继续同测，新增位置也保持对齐。任意有限的同一命令序列都有相应形成历史，旧配置完整保留，形成的新位置数一致。

因此，后续几处关系可以继续引用前面同一次形成的结果，不必每次独立重新选代表。这个关系语义并不授权复制物理资源，也不证明实际记忆装置已经形成；实际可用性和执行仍应由完整模型承担。

## 99. 哪一种区别被证明不可抹去

新的无名称问题“让保留的同一片段占据两个输入位置，是否还能接合”，正确识别了上述压缩错误。更直接地，Lean 已证明：在同一个单次消耗过程里，任何精确回答这些配置问题的说明，都必须区分初始空历史与已消耗历史。

这个必要区别定理不要求说明最小，也不要求有限分支，没有另外添加成功或善的谓词。它来自同一过程里可接续与不可接续的真实差异。

这推进了原问题的一个核心回答：当“前面形成的东西怎样继续起作用”属于所解释内容时，几个后续位置是否共同指向同一形成片段，也必须被保留。仅有若干分别成立的存在关系不足以代替这个依存关系。这里的同一性是由所解释的接续后果要求保留的，不是把预设独立实体的全部身份都强加为解释门槛。
